prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental ambient piece about building a tone from stacked sines. Around 66 BPM, A Lydian. Pure sine synthesizers enter one partial at a time; a marimba occasionally states the fundamental. Transparent, additive, almost diagrammatic. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No distortion, no drums, no supersaw stack.

[00:00–00:25] Single sine fundamental, centered.
[00:25–01:05] Odd partials fade in, beating slightly, forming a lattice in the stereo field.
[01:05–01:50] Marimba plays the fundamental in slow notes; even partials complete the chord.
[01:50–02:30] Partials remove in reverse order until only the opening sine remains.
